summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Azories digital book creation platform after pod restart. Backend APIs now functioning at 100% success rate. Frontend core functionality verified with minor session persistence issue identified.

integration_issues.issue: Session persistence issue - after successful registration, user gets redirected back to auth page instead of staying on dashboard

passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with Azories branding
Library tabs (All, Featured, Best of Week) working
Theme toggle works (light to dark mode switching)
User registration form functional (name, email, password fields)
Free subscription status visible on dashboard
Upgrade to Pro buttons visible for free users
Backend API endpoints (23/23 tests passed - 100% success rate)
Book, chapter, page CRUD operations functional
TTS voice API now functional (9 voices available)
Admin features (featured books, best of week) working
Genre and basic utility endpoints working
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session persistence issue: After successful user registration, the user is redirected back to the authentication page instead of staying on the dashboard. This prevents users from completing the upgrade to Pro and book creation workflow. The issue appears to be related to authentication token storage or session management.
